historical_table.description: One table of the Historical Tables of the President's Budget (Table s.t, e.g. 1.1 receipts, outlays and deficits since 1789; 3.2 outlays by function and subfunction; 7.1 federal debt; 10.1 GDP and deflators), read as published: title and units in the notes, multi-row headers joined ("Total Outlays", "On-Budget Receipts"), footnotes in the notes, label rows kept, column sheet_row. The pack reads granule TAB-<s+1>-<t> and checks its title; an edition without that file (FY2026: one workbook) is read from the package zip.

fy.desc: the budget's fiscal year (edition), e.g. 2027 for the budget released in 2026; default: the newest edition GovInfo has (tries next year, this year, last year)

table.desc: table number s.t as published, e.g. "1.1", "3.2", "8.5" (or a catalog alias such as table_1_1)

granule.desc: set by the adapter from table (s.t -> <s+1>-<t>)

header_row.desc: optional: 1-based row of the (first) column-name row; default: detected

header_rows.desc: optional: how many header rows to join; default: detected (rows under the first header row whose first cell is empty)

budget_database.description: The Public Budget Database: one row per budget account (or receipt account) with agency, bureau, account, Treasury and CGAC codes, subfunction, BEA category (Mandatory, Discretionary, Net interest), on-/off-budget, and one column per fiscal year (1962 on for outlays and receipts, 1976 on for budget authority, TQ = 1976 transition quarter) in thousands of dollars, through the budget's last projection year. About 5,000-6,000 rows (receipts about 260).

fy.desc: the budget's fiscal year (edition), e.g. 2027 for the budget released in 2026; default: the newest edition GovInfo has (tries next year, this year, last year)

granule.desc: set by the adapter from kind

header_row.desc: optional: 1-based row of the (first) column-name row; default: detected

header_rows.desc: optional: how many header rows to join; default: detected (rows under the first header row whose first cell is empty)

credit_supplement.description: One table of the Federal Credit Supplement: Table 1 direct loans and Table 2 loan guarantees (subsidy rates in percent, obligations or commitments and average loan size in thousands of dollars, for the current year and the budget year, by agency, bureau, program and risk category); Tables 3-6 subsidy assumptions; Tables 7-8 subsidy reestimates by cohort; Tables 9-10 disbursement rates. Label rows (agency, bureau, account) are kept in published order.

fy.desc: the budget's fiscal year (edition), e.g. 2027 for the budget released in 2026; default: the newest edition GovInfo has (tries next year, this year, last year)

table.desc: table number 1-10 (1 = direct loan subsidy rates, 2 = loan guarantee subsidy rates)

header_row.desc: optional: 1-based row of the (first) column-name row; default: detected

header_rows.desc: optional: how many header rows to join; default: detected (rows under the first header row whose first cell is empty)
